description: Returns the reference data for AgentSLA's escrow contract on Base Mainnet: contract and USDC token addresses, chain id, the pass price and period, the 2% escrow fee, the 7-day reclaim timeout, the human-readable ABI of the functions agents call, and a Basescan link. Use it to verify the addresses that buy_pass and create_escrow_job put in their transactions. Free, read-only, static.
name: get_usdc_escrow_contract
title: Escrow contract reference
